features.name: z_center_l2_distance_scaled
features.description: Euclidean distance from the unsupervised training-fold mean profile after per-column standardization, divided by a fold-based upper scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves radial neighborhood geometry around a generic central prototype.

features.name: z_center_l1_distance_scaled
features.description: Sum of absolute standardized deviations from the unsupervised mean profile, scaled to a near-unit interval for the training fold.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds Manhattan-style robust centrality that can help nearest-neighbor search when one coordinate is noisy.

features.name: z_center_chebyshev_distance_scaled
features.description: Largest absolute standardized departure from the unsupervised mean profile, scaled by the observed fold span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights rows dominated by one extreme coordinate, improving local distance shape for outlying contours.

features.name: z_mean_axis_position_scaled
features.description: Signed standardized projection along the common high-versus-low direction across all five measurements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves broad directional shift information that pure distance features discard.

features.name: z_adjacent_smoothness_scaled
features.description: Scaled mean absolute adjacent difference across the ordered standardized measurements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes contour smoothness so rows with similar adjacent transitions are placed nearer together.

features.name: z_adjacent_curvature_scaled
features.description: Scaled average absolute second difference across the ordered standardized measurements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures bends in the acoustic contour, helping KNN align rows with similar local shape.

features.name: raw_mean_cosine_similarity
features.description: Cosine similarity between the raw row vector and the unsupervised training-fold mean vector.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds angle-based similarity that is less sensitive to raw magnitude than Euclidean distance.

features.name: range_low_corner_distance_scaled
features.description: RMS distance from the low-value corner of the training-fold bounding box after range scaling and clipping.
features.expected_model_benefit: Anchors neighborhoods with respect to one generic box-corner prototype, improving geometry near low-range regions.

features.name: range_high_corner_distance_scaled
features.description: RMS distance from the high-value corner of the training-fold bounding box after range scaling and clipping.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a complementary generic box-corner distance that helps KNN respect boundary-side similarity.

features.name: central_core_indicator
features.description: Binary flag for rows lying within one standard deviation of the training-fold mean in every measurement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a coarse central-region marker that can stabilize local neighborhoods around dense areas.

features.name: outer_shell_indicator
features.description: Binary flag for rows with at least one measurement beyond two standard deviations from its training-fold mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies edge-region rows so nearest-neighbor distances can account for sparse outer-shell behavior.

features.name: phoneme_contour_coherence_judgment
features.description: A 0-1 expert score derived from the five ordered acoustic measurements that rates whether the contour looks internally coherent, smooth, and plausible relative to unsupervised training-fold ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a soft contour-level similarity cue for neighbor ranking when formula distances miss perceptual shape cues.
